letter_en:
[Date]

[Landlord name]
[Landlord address]

Re: Rent increase notice for 4200 Fairmount Ave, San Diego, CA 92105

Dear [Landlord name],

I received notice that my rent will rise from $2,100.00 to $2,350.00 effective December 1, 2026. Under California Civil Code 1947.12 (AB 1482), the increase for this period may not exceed 8.2% of the lowest rent charged in the prior 12 months, which sets a maximum of $2,272.20. The proposed rent exceeds that limit by $77.80 per month.

Please revise the increase to no more than $2,272.20 and confirm in writing.

Sincerely,
[Tenant name]
disclaimer: This is not legal advice. For help with a rent increase, contact the Legal Aid Society of San Diego (lassd.org, 877-534-2524).
